title: frametrail:attributes of type "spotify"
description: Spotify track, album, playlist or podcast. The src is the open.spotify.com URL. This schema describes the frametrail:attributes of items (and the attributes of resources) whose type is "spotify". On overlays, opacity, hoverStyle, zIndex and animation apply as on every overlay type. Unknown keys are allowed; writers keep them.

html.description: Embed HTML from Spotify's oEmbed answer. Used instead of an iframe of src when present.
